name: Necromantic Bulwark

currentBonuses.bonus: +your raised shield's circumstance bonus (usually +1; +2 for a tower shield)
currentBonuses.when: while your shield is raised, on saves against effects that would deal void damage

evidence: "When you have your shield raised, you gain your shield's circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would deal void damage."

corrections.problem: Wrong bonus magnitude in the parenthetical. The spec writes the bonus as "+your raised shield's circumstance bonus (usually +1; +2 for a tower shield)", which inverts the actual shield values. core.json: items/buckler acBonus 1, items/steel-shield acBonus 2, items/tower-shield acBonus 2. The +1 case is the buckler (the uncommon case); +2 is the normal shield, tower shields included. The feat itself says only "you gain your shield's circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would deal void damage" — it names no numbers, so the parenthetical is the reviewer's gloss and it will be read at the table as "+1" by most shield users who actually get +2.
corrections.correction: Keep situational true, targetKind save / save 'all', when "while your shield is raised, on saves against effects that would deal void damage". Change the bonus string to "+your raised shield's circumstance bonus (+2 for most shields, +1 for a buckler)". Optionally note that a tower shield's bonus rises to +4 only while you are also using Take Cover, which is an AC-specific clause the feat does not address (flag as needsHumanDecision if you want that resolved).

name: Spiral Sworn

currentBonuses.bonus: +status equal to your number of weapon damage dice
currentBonuses.when: for 3 rounds after you use Spiral Sworn, on damage against undead, creatures holding an imprisoned soul, or creatures you have seen create or command undead

currentBonuses.bonus: +status equal to the spell's rank (to damage)
currentBonuses.when: for 3 rounds after you use Spiral Sworn, for damaging spells cast from spell slots that have no duration, against undead / imprisoned-soul carriers / undead-creators

evidence: "For 3 rounds, your Strikes and spells deal additional damage against undead... You gain a status bonus to damage with your Strikes against these creatures equal to the number of weapon damage dice. Spells you cast from spell slots gain a status bonus to damage against these creatures equal to the rank of the spell; this bonus applies only to spells that deal damage and don't have a duration."

corrections.problem: Wrong target on the second bonus. The feat grants "a status bonus to damage" for spells cast from slots — it is a SPELL DAMAGE bonus. The spec maps it to targetKind 'spell', which in this registry is the spellcasting attack roll / spell DC stat, and then admits in engineNote that this is 'a best-effort mapping'. Starring the spellcasting attack/DC with '+status equal to the spell's rank' actively invites the player to add it to a spell attack roll or their spell DC, neither of which the text grants. Same class of error the brief warns about (a damage bonus recorded on an attack/DC stat).
corrections.correction: Drop the targetKind 'spell' entry entirely. Keep the strikeDamage entry ("+status equal to your number of weapon damage dice", for 3 rounds, vs undead / creatures holding an imprisoned soul / creatures you have witnessed create or command undead — note core.json says 'witnessed', not 'seen'). Keep needsEngineWork true, with the note now reading: spell DAMAGE has no target kind in the list (the 'spell' kind is the spellcasting attack/DC), so this half cannot be marked until a spell-damage marker or a Spells-tab display exists; also the whole package can be redirected to a willing creature in the spiral's light, which the registry cannot express.

corrections.problem: The second emitted bonus puts a SPELL DAMAGE bonus on targetKind 'spell'. In the allowed target list 'spell' is the spellcasting attack/DC stat (there is a separate 'strikeAttack' and 'strikeDamage', but no spell-damage kind). Starring the spell stat with '+status equal to the spell's rank' would read to a player as if their spell attack rolls and spell DC gained up to +10, which is a far larger and completely different claim than the text makes. The record says only: 'Spells you cast from spell slots gain a status bonus to damage against these creatures equal to the rank of the spell; this bonus applies only to spells that deal damage and don't have a duration.' The author already recognised the mismatch in engineNote but emitted the entry anyway — and inconsistently, since the identical class of problem was correctly left unemitted in stalwart-standard and thats-not-natural.
corrections.correction: Keep the strikeDamage entry ('+status equal to your number of weapon damage dice', for 3 rounds, against undead / creatures holding an imprisoned soul / creatures you have witnessed create or command undead) and DROP the targetKind:'spell' entry. Leave situational true and needsEngineWork true, with the engineNote asking for a spell-damage marker (a Spells-tab marker or a new kind) plus the unexpressible 'if your spiral is glowing you can redirect the whole package to a willing creature in its light' clause.

name: Gravelands Herbalist

currentBonuses.bonus: +3 item (+4 with Lastwall Soup (Greater), per the feat text)
currentBonuses.when: for 1 hour after you eat improved or greater Lastwall soup, to Stealth checks and DCs against undead

evidence: Feat: "At 10th level, you can make Lastwall Soup (Improved) that grants a +3 item bonus. At 18th level, you can make Lastwall Soup (Greater) that grants a +4 item bonus..." The bonus itself is defined on the consumable — items/lastwall-soup: "you gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead"; items/lastwall-soup-improved: "+3 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead".

corrections.problem: The bonus ladder is incomplete and starts too high. The feat's first effect is "Add Lastwall soup to your list of herbal items" — at 4th level the holder makes BASE Lastwall soup, which items/lastwall-soup gives as "a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead". The spec's single entry begins at +3 and its 'when' says "after you eat improved or greater Lastwall soup", so levels 4-9 (the majority of the feat's life) are unrepresented. Secondary: the bonus is to "Stealth checks and DCs against undead" and only the check half is captured — the DC half is the same DC gap flagged on other records, but it is not mentioned here.
corrections.correction: Both human-decision questions are CONFIRMED and should stay: (a) the feat by itself grants nothing until soup is eaten, and (b) the +3/+4 conflict is real — feats/gravelands-herbalist says Greater grants "+4 item bonus" while items/lastwall-soup-greater's own text says "+3 item bonus" (and still calls itself 'improved Lastwall soup', so that record looks like a copy-paste of the Improved entry). Fix the emitted bonus to the full ladder: "+2 item (base soup), +3 at 10th (Improved), +4 at 18th (Greater, per the feat; the item record says +3)", when: "for 1 hour after you eat Lastwall soup, to Stealth checks and DCs against undead". Add to the engine note that the 'and DCs' half has no target kind.

corrections.problem: The single emitted bonus starts at '+3 item' and its 'when' covers only 'improved or greater Lastwall soup'. But the feat's first effect is 'Add Lastwall soup to your list of herbal items', and items/lastwall-soup grants '+2 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead' — so from feat level 4 through 9 the only soup the feat unlocks gives +2, not +3. The +3 does not exist until 10th level and the +4 until 18th. As written the entry would show a level-4 character a bonus one point too large.
corrections.correction: If the app owner answers question (a) with 'register it on the feat', the entry should read: bonus '+2 item (+3 with Lastwall Soup (Improved) at 10th level, +4 with Lastwall Soup (Greater) at 18th level, per the feat text)', when 'for 1 hour after you eat Lastwall soup, to Stealth checks and DCs against undead'. Keep needsHumanDecision true — and note that the +3/+4 conflict in question (b) is real and resolvable: items/lastwall-soup-greater's description is a verbatim copy of the Improved one (it still says 'after consuming a bowl of improved Lastwall soup' and '+3 item bonus' while carrying the greater item's level 18 and 10 temp HP), so the item record looks like the copy-paste bug and the feat's +4 is the likely authority. Add that observation to the question rather than leaving it a coin flip.

name: Bodysnatcher

currentBonuses.bonus: +4 circumstance (to your Deception DC, not to your Deception checks)
currentBonuses.when: while impersonating a creature whose flesh you Consumed with Bodysnatcher, against attempts to see through the disguise (lasts until you're no longer satiated)

evidence: "Your transformation automatically defeats Perception DCs to determine you are a member of the ancestry or creature type into which you transformed, and you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC to prevent others from seeing through your disguise."

corrections.problem: Inconsistent DC handling, and needsHumanDecision is wrongly false. The +4 circumstance bonus is to your Deception DC (what observers roll Perception against), not to any Deception check — the spec says so itself and still emits a skill/deception marker. In the same batch the reviewer deliberately emitted NOTHING for the identical DC-only situations: stalwart-standard (allies' Fortitude/Reflex DCs) and that's-not-natural (your Perception DC vs those creatures' Stealth). So the same problem is resolved two different ways, and the Deception star can be misread as +4 on Impersonate checks.
corrections.correction: Either emit nothing (consistent with stalwart-standard and that's-not-natural) or emit for all three — but do not decide it silently. Set needsHumanDecision true with the question: "Should a bonus that applies only to a DERIVED DC (Deception DC vs Impersonate, Perception DC vs Stealth, Fort/Reflex DC vs Disarm/Grapple/Shove/Trip) get a star on the underlying check, or be suppressed until a DC concept exists?" If it is kept, the current 'when' wording is already explicit enough; the condition itself checks out — the disguise lasts until you are no longer satiated and works once per individual creature.

corrections.problem: The emitted bonus stars skill/deception for a +4 that does not apply to Deception checks at all. The record says: 'you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC to prevent others from seeing through your disguise' — that is the DC observers roll Perception against, not your check modifier. A star on the Deception row is the wrong side of the roll, and the disclaimer buried in the 'when' string does not undo the marker appearing on a stat that gets no bonus. The same author correctly emitted nothing for the Fortitude/Reflex DC half of stalwart-standard and nothing for the Perception DC half of thats-not-natural, so this entry is also internally inconsistent. (Foundry's bodysnatcher.json carries no rule elements, so nothing supports a check-side bonus.)
corrections.correction: Emit NO bonuses. Keep situational true and needsEngineWork true with an engineNote saying the +4 circumstance bonus applies to the holder's Deception DC against attempts to see through a Bodysnatcher disguise (and that the transformation auto-defeats Perception DCs to identify the ancestry/creature type), and that the sheet has no skill-DC concept to attach it to. Re-emit as skill/deception only if the app owner later decides a skill-DC marker should live on the skill row.

corrections.correction: Mark this spec as a REPLACEMENT, not an addition. Delete line 321's perception entry and author only `"supertaster": [{ targets: [{ kind: 'skill', detail: 'all' }], when: "when you lick or taste something while Investigating or Recalling Knowledge to identify it, and the taste is relevant (GM's call)", bonus: "+2 circumstance" }]`. name: Glyph Expert

against attacks made by magical traps

name: Muscle Mimicry

currentBonuses.bonus: +1 circumstance (+2 if the enemy critically succeeded)
currentBonuses.when: to your Athletics check the next time you use the same maneuver (Disarm, Escape, Grapple, Shove, or Trip) an enemy just succeeded at against you; lost if unused by the end of your next turn

corrections.problem: Invented condition. corrections.problem: The condition adds a restriction the record does not contain. core.json's trigger is "An enemy makes a successful Disarm, Escape, Grapple, Shove, or Trip attempt" — full stop, no target named — and the body says "The next time you take the same action they did". The spec's 'when' says the enemy succeeded "against you". By RAW the feat also fires when you watch an enemy Grapple your ally or Escape from anyone; the spec's phrasing would tell a player at the table they had nothing, when they do. Low severity (it narrows rather than inflates) but it is still condition text that is not in the record.
corrections.correction: Change 'when' to: "to your Athletics check the next time you take the same action (Disarm, Escape, Grapple, Shove, or Trip) that an enemy just succeeded at; lost if you don't use it before the end of your next turn". Everything else is right — +1 circumstance, +2 if the enemy critically succeeded, skill/athletics, situational true.

name: Psychic Duelist Dedication

currentBonuses.bonus: status bonus equal to the spell's rank
currentBonuses.when: to mental damage dealt by your spells, during a psychic duel in which you chose Mind Mace

evidence: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative rolls for psychic duels... Mind Mace: You gain a status bonus to mental damage with spells you cast equal to the spell's rank.

corrections.problem: Wrong target for the only bonus emitted. Mind Mace reads "You gain a status bonus to mental damage with spells you cast equal to the spell's rank" — that is spell DAMAGE, but the spec files it under targetKind 'spell', which in the sheet is the spell attack/DC line. The spec's own engineNote concedes it "may render on the wrong number", yet still emits it, so the star would land on a stat the feat never touches. Secondarily, the engineNote's blanket claim that "there is no initiative stat in the list" overstates the gap: the existing registry already files initiative bonuses under perception (e.g. 'all-this-has-happened-before' — "on your initiative roll (once per day)"; 'ambush-awareness' — "on Perception checks rolled for initiative").
corrections.correction: Emit NO bonus entry for this record. Set situational false/needsEngineWork true with the note: spell-damage has no target kind (only strikeDamage exists), Psychic Fist is an attribute substitution, and the +2 circumstance to psychic-duel initiative can only be filed under 'perception' IF duel initiative is a Perception roll — core.json's rules/psychic-duels record is empty (id + name only), so that is unverifiable from the data. Keep the human-decision question about duel-only bonuses.

corrections.problem: A real, printed bonus is dropped from bonuses[] on a false premise. The text opens with "You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative rolls for psychic duels" — that is a genuine typed circumstance bonus on the character's own roll, and it is the ONLY part of this feat that isn't gated on a mid-duel choice. The engineNote justifies omitting it with "there is no initiative stat in the list", which is factually wrong about this codebase: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts already carries initiative bonuses under kind 'perception' ("all-this-has-happened-before" — "on your initiative roll (once per day)"; "swaggering-initiative" — "rolling initiative"; "ambush-awareness", "proximity-alert", "mediums-awareness"). So the record ends up with zero coverage for its least ambiguous benefit for a stated reason that does not hold.
corrections.correction: Either add an entry — bonus "+2 circumstance", when "on initiative rolls for psychic duels", targetKind 'perception' (matching the existing all-this-has-happened-before / swaggering-initiative precedent) — or, if it is held back, hold it back on the correct ground: rules/psychic-duels in core.json has an id and name but no description, so the data cannot confirm the duel's initiative roll is Perception-based, and filing it under perception could mark the wrong stat. Replace the 'no initiative stat' claim in engineNote with that. The rest of the spec stands: Mind Mace is correctly scoped to "during a psychic duel in which you chose Mind Mace" ("Each time you enter a psychic duel, choose one of the following benefits for the duration of that duel"), the spell-DAMAGE vs spell-attack/DC concern is real, Psychic Fist is correctly identified as a substitution, and the needsHumanDecision question about duel-only bonuses is legitimate.

name: Anchor Stance

while in Anchor Stance (you must be in or under water): to your Reflex DC against Reposition and Shove, and to Reflex saves against effects that would force you to move

name: Not This Time

currentBonuses.when: against the triggering single-target spell or ability, if the creature fails its save against your DC
against the triggering single-target spell or ability, if the creature fails its save against your DC

evidence: "If your AC is being targeted, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC. If you need to attempt a saving throw, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the save."

corrections.problem: The condition is narrowed beyond the text. Both bonus entries say the +2 applies "if the creature fails its save against your DC", but the record grants it on the creature's SUCCESS as well: "**Success** ... If your AC is being targeted, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC. If you need to attempt a saving throw, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the save." Only a Critical Success denies the bonus ("The spell or ability affects you normally"); on a Critical Failure the effect fails outright so no bonus is needed. As written the spec tells a player they get nothing on the enemy's success, which is wrong half the time.
corrections.correction: Reword both 'when' strings to cover success and failure, e.g. "against the triggering single-target spell or ability, unless the creature critically succeeds at its save against your class or spell DC (spend a Mythic Point)". Keep the engineNote's separate point that the crit-downgrade rider only happens on the creature's failure — that part is correct.

corrections.problem: The condition is narrowed beyond the text. The spec's 'when' says the bonuses apply "if the creature fails its save against your DC" — but the record grants the +2 on BOTH degrees in the middle: "**Success** ... If your AC is being targeted, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC. If you need to attempt a saving throw, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the save." and "**Failure** ... you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC, and a critical hit against you becomes a normal hit ... a +2 circumstance bonus to the save, and if you critically fail, you fail instead." As written the player would think a Success on the enemy's save gives them nothing. The Mythic Point cost is also omitted from the condition.
corrections.correction: Keep both entries (+2 circumstance, targetKind ac / save 'all') but rewrite the 'when' as: "against the triggering single-target spell or ability, after you spend a Mythic Point and the creature's save against your class or spell DC is a success or a failure (no bonus on its critical success; on its critical failure the effect fails outright)". Only the defence the effect targets gets the bonus — that part of the note is right.

name: Thaumaturgic Ritualist

Checking core.json's `ritualPrimary` field across all 151 ritual records, 28 of them (18.5%) name NO tradition skill at all: e.g. clone -> "Crafting (legendary)", seed-of-mercy -> "Medicine (expert)", wild-allegiance -> "Diplomacy (expert)", power-of-the-beasts -> "Athletics (expert)", the-unseeing-blade-master -> "Perception (master)", halt-death -> "Warfare Lore (legendary)", bonding-meal -> "Cooking Lore, Crafting, Performance, or Survival (trained)", band-of-heroes -> "Diplomacy (mythic) or Society (mythic)". So roughly one ritual in five would show no marker. The engineNote's "a handful of rituals" understates this by an order of magnitude, and it is inconsistent with the same author's use of skill 'all' for Recall Knowledge (instructive-strike, willing-runes), which is a NARROWER set of skills than ritual primary checks.

(One ritual's primary check is even literally 'any' — unfettered-mark -> "Crafting (master) or any (legendary)".) Note that Perception is also a legal primary check for the-unseeing-blade-master, so a perception entry is defensible too if the app owner wants full coverage.

The record reads "For the next 10 minutes, you gain a +2 status bonus to checks made using Acrobatics, Occultism, Stealth, or Survival" — this is the standard PF2e enumerating construction ('checks made using any of these'), not a choose-one. Nothing in the text offers a choice: there is no 'choose one', no 'one of the following', and the duration is a flat 10 minutes rather than per-check. In PF2e, Shove is Athletics vs the target's FORTITUDE DC (like Grapple); only Disarm and Trip target Reflex DC. As specced the star would land on the wrong defence for Shove.
